**Preparing JSON output**

The user wants me to paraphrase something into JSON format. I’ll wrap the entire output in JSON and include a field named "paraphrase." Backticks are allowed, and I need to ensure my paraphrase captures the facts without extra commentary. It should be a JSON object with string values, using plain text. I’ll format it with double quotes and escape if necessary, keeping it clear and concise with a single key "paraphrase" as one string.
[/Thinking]

{
  "paraphrase": "She is the clairvoyant daughter of one of Europe’s longest-serving monarchs; he bills himself as a sixth-generation shaman from California. Their Saturday wedding in Geiranger was far from a standard royal event, yet crowds still gathered along the grey streets hoping to see the bride. Princess Märtha Louise of Norway, 52 and the only daughter of King Harald and Queen Sonja, is fourth in line to the throne. She and 49-year-old Durek Verrett exchanged vows in a Church of Norway service, followed by a ceremony at the four-star Hotel Union in the village beneath the Geiranger fjord. The princess was accompanied by seven bridesmaids, including Leah and Emma Behn, teenage daughters from her previous marriage to the late writer Ari Behn, whom she divorced in 2017. About 350 guests attended, among them her brother Crown Prince Haakon and his wife Crown Princess Mette-Marit, Sweden’s Crown Princess Victoria and Prince Daniel, and Prince Constantijn and Princess Laurentien of the Netherlands. Märtha Louise has long lived an unconventional royal life, having once claimed clairvoyant abilities and run a healing school focused on communicating with angels. In 2022 she announced she would step back from official royal duties to concentrate on business ventures with Verrett and to more clearly separate their activities from the royal household. Verrett, who calls himself a “servant of God” and “energy activator” on Instagram, counts clients such as Goop founder Gwyneth Paltrow, whom he has referred to as a “soul sister.”"
}
